overview_description.description:
ThreeFlow is a Benefits Placement System, a new category of enterprise software that allows brokers and carriers to manage the entire placement process in one shared system. They make it easier for carriers to win business and brokers to empower employers with the details they need to make benefits selections. By connecting people, systems, and information, they enable easier communication, a quicker process, and better decisions making busy people more productive. 

ThreeFlow was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL, USA.

about_short_description.short_description: ThreeFlow is an employee benefits software that allows brokers and carriers to manage the entire placement process.

product.name: ThreeFlow Benefits Placement System
product.description: A software platform that enables brokers and carriers to manage the entire employee benefits placement process, including renewals, new business RFPs, analysis, negotiation, and implementation.

product.name: ThreeFlow Connect
product.description: An integration service that connects ThreeFlow with agency management systems and Salesforce to automate client setup and post-sale data transfer.

product.name: Smart Proposals
product.description: A feature that uses AI to read carrier proposal documents and generate populated quotes ready for review within minutes.

product.name: Digital Analysis and Negotiation
product.description: A tool that enables real-time collaboration between brokers and carriers to analyze benefit line items, compare quotes side-by-side, and access quote history.

product.name: Renewal Management
product.description: A system to collect, schedule, and manage benefits renewals according to preferred timelines and workflows.

product.name: Real-time, In-app Market Data (ThreeFlow Insights)
product.description: An analytics tool providing brokers and carriers with real-time data on market activity, carrier response rates, new business premiums, and other metrics to inform revenue planning and competitive analysis.
